from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ROUTE = ROOT / 'backend' / 'modules' / 'worker_runtime_wake' / 'routes.py'


def test_wake_is_code_tree_aware_but_keeps_fixed_service_guard():
    text = ROUTE.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'WORKER_TREE_STATE = RUNTIME_DIR / "active_worker_code_tree_sha"' in text
    assert 'WORKER_CODE_TREE_SPEC = "HEAD:tools/mirror_sync"' in text
    assert '["git", "rev-parse", WORKER_CODE_TREE_SPEC]' in text
    assert 'worker_code_current = active_worker_tree == current_worker_tree' in text
    assert 'heartbeat_age is not None and heartbeat_age <= 90 and worker_code_current' in text
    assert 'WORKER_TREE_STATE.write_text(current_worker_tree + "\n"' in text
    assert 'WORKER_SERVICE = "edarsahub-universal-worker"' in text
    assert '["supervisorctl", "restart", WORKER_SERVICE]' in text
    assert 'production_touched' in text


def test_wake_still_requires_exact_remote_queue_sha():
    text = ROUTE.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'QUEUE_REF = "refs/heads/worker/requests"' in text
    assert 'if supplied.lower() != current:' in text
    assert 'detail="stale worker queue proof"' in text
